coverage.evidence: TextTemplateHelpers.cs:44 sets the namespace text and lines 54-63 send each key to its group. TemplateParser.cs:148-157 puts the inputs after a colon and splits them on pipes. TemplateParser.cs:127-135 turns a typed backslash-s into a space and backslash-n into a line break. The parser never trims an input (TemplateParser.cs:53-117), so a text keeps its spaces. ParsedArgument.cs:24-28 trims numbers. There are 103 distinct text.* keys across the Helpers/Text/*.cs files, the same as the description and the 103 table rows.

Each example was traced in its group: CaseTextHelpers.cs:19-71, FancyTextHelpers.cs:23-141, NamingTextHelpers.cs:25-65, PlayfulTextHelpers.cs:20-99, CountTextHelpers.cs:19-53, SliceTextHelpers.cs:20-84, WordPickTextHelpers.cs:20-89, SpacingTextHelpers.cs:17-43, WrapTextHelpers.cs:17-30, StripTextHelpers.cs:24-73, EncodingTextHelpers.cs:21-46, LanguageTextHelpers.cs:42-86, PluralTextHelpers.cs:24-51, ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:17-56, CutTextHelpers.cs:17-87, PadTextHelpers.cs:17-56, and TextTransformCatalog.cs:43-51, 95-107 and 125-142. The rule that a helper with null output prints as written is at TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19 and 117-118.

TextHelperRow.cs:42 gives every row TemplateHelperContexts.StandardAndViewer. TemplateHelperContexts.cs:25-26 defines that as every TemplateHelperContext value. TemplateHelperContext.cs:21-63 lists them: Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook and Viewer. That matches the Use in column.

TextArguments.cs:20-24 accepts a count only from 0 to 1000, and ParsedArgument.cs:27-28 uses NumberStyles.None, so a sign is refused. Positions must be at least 1: SliceTextHelpers.cs:55 and WordPickTextHelpers.cs:88-89. A position past the end gives empty text through Skip/Take (WordPickTextHelpers.cs:34, 70). Each helper checks its input count, for example ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:41 and PadTextHelpers.cs:38. The plural helpers parse any signed long at PluralTextHelpers.cs:53-59.

text.cut needs max, defaults end to an ellipsis, and counts the end inside the max (CutTextHelpers.cs:32-46). text.truncate and text.cut.words append an ellipsis (TextTransformCatalog.cs:142, CutTextHelpers.cs:50-58). text.length.fit adds no ending (SliceTextHelpers.cs:64-67). Pad and center default to a space (PadTextHelpers.cs:36-46). In viewer text the repeat count (input 0) and the pad width (input 1) are capped at TextCountLimit (PadTextHelpers.cs:19-29, TextHelperGroup.cs:41-56), which is 20 (IViewerTemplateResolver.cs:40-41, TemplateResolver.cs:121).

text.replace and text.replace.first use StringComparison.Ordinal and text.replace.icase uses OrdinalIgnoreCase (ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:20-30). text.remove is an Ordinal replace (ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:53-56) and text.count is Ordinal (CountTextHelpers.cs:50-51). text.censor uses RegexOptions.IgnoreCase (StripTextHelpers.cs:56-60). An empty search text returns null at ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:41, CountTextHelpers.cs:45 and StripTextHelpers.cs:53.

text.plural and text.plural.count take a signed whole count and choose the singular when Math.Abs(n) == 1 (PluralTextHelpers.cs:32-39, 53-59). text.plural.auto uses Humanizer Pluralize (PluralTextHelpers.cs:42-48). text.join.and and text.join.or use and/or in English, en/of in Dutch, and fall back to English (LanguageTextHelpers.cs:26-31, 59-63). text.article returns the word unchanged when the channel language is not English (LanguageTextHelpers.cs:66-77).

reader_answers.evidence: text.replace takes text, find and replacement in that order (ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:41-47). replace.first and replace.icase are at lines 22-30. text.plural, plural.count and plural.auto take the count first (PluralTextHelpers.cs:32-48). Nested {args} renders first, because arguments render inside out (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:108-115).
The contexts are StandardAndViewer (TextHelperRow.cs:42). Viewer text needs the Viewer context and a viewer render (TemplateResolver.cs:124-128).

A null result prints the token as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19, 117-118). Null is returned for a wrong input count, an out-of-range count, a position below 1 or an empty search text (TextArguments.cs:23-24, WordPickTextHelpers.cs:88-89, ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:41).

Replace matches case exactly with Ordinal and returns null on an empty search text (ReplaceTextHelpers.cs:20, 41). Plural gives the singular for 1 or -1 and accepts negative numbers (PluralTextHelpers.cs:37, 53-59). The count is the first input in all three plural helpers (PluralTextHelpers.cs:34, 44).
